description: 擲彈兵（grenadier）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 擲彈兵

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a grenadier, sturdy and compact, about six and a half heads tall: an olive-green military uniform with olive armor plates, a helmet with a dark visor, ammo pouches and grenade bandolier across the chest, shoulder pauldron, forearm guards and knee pads, black boots, dark gloves, amber yellow neon lines.
